jobs.description_text: Get to Know the Team The Fulfilment Tech Family builds distributed systems and machine learning platforms that power Grab's multi-sided marketplace across Southeast Asia. We process hundreds of millions of real-time requests each day to manage supply allocation, dispatch, order matching, and dynamic pricing across mobility and deliveries. Our mission is to balance customer reliability, driver-partner earnings, and operational efficiency under volatile real-world conditions. We foster a collaborative, research-to-production culture focused on scalable algorithmic impact. Get to Know the Role As Senior Principal Data Scientist, you will be the senior individual contributor lead architecting Grab's next generation of autonomous marketplace decisioning systems. Working at the intersection of reinforcement learning, latent world models, and generative AI, you will guide technical strategy and translate research into production systems serving millions of users. You will be the technical lead for a specialised team of scientists and engineers, reporting directly to the Head of Data Science. You will also base full-time onsite at Grab's One-North office in Singapore. If you are passionate about pioneering real-time, learning-driven marketplace systems at massive scale, join us! The Critical Tasks You Will Perform You will architect and implement end-to-end reinforcement learning pipelines (offline RL, model-based RL, and simulation) to jointly automate pricing, dispatch, and supply repositioning decisions. You will design latent world models and spatio-temporal marketplace state representations that capture complex supply-demand interactions and multi-temporal levers. You will establish formal off-policy evaluation (OPE) frameworks, conservative value estimation baselines, and safety guardrails to de-risk live deployment in production. You will build behavioural simulation systems using fine-tuned open-source large language models (LLMs) to forecast and simulate user and partner decision dynamics. You will partner with backend, streaming, and platform engineering teams to deploy low-latency, closed-loop decision agents into high-throughput production environments. You will leverage modern Generative AI development tools and AI-assisted workflows to accelerate prototyping, code quality, testing, and technical documentation across the team. What Essential Skills You Will Need You have a PhD in Computer Science, Operations Research, Applied Mathematics, or a related quantitative discipline with at least 10 years of post-degree experience leading complex machine learning research and production initiatives (or Master's degree with at least 12 years of equivalent experience). You are proficient in reinforcement learning foundations, including Markov Decision Processes, stochastic control, offline RL, and reward shaping for sequential multi-objective decision systems. You have proven experience deploying production ML/RL systems operating under real-time constraints, non-stationary data, and distribution shifts. You have hands-on expertise with large language model adaptation and alignment, including supervised fine-tuning (SFT), parameter-efficient methods (LoRA/QLoRA), and preference tuning (RLHF, DPO, or GRPO). You have hands-on proficiency in Python, PyTorch, and distributed training/compute platforms such as Ray, DeepSpeed, FSDP, or Megatron-LM. You have experience engaging with AI tools and emerging technologies to enhance productivity, improve workflows, and contribute new ideas. We are building a user-centric intelligence capability that helps Grabbers, managers, People teams, and business leaders understand what is happening, identify what matters, and take effective action. Get to Know the Role As Data Scientist, People Analytics you will apply strategic consulting, applied research, and structured problem-solving to complex people and organisational challenges. You will build AI systems and agents that automate People Science workflows, develop an organisational listening engine that turns signals into action, and advise People and business leaders on real problems. This is a hands-on role requiring research rigour, analytical judgement, and user-centric product thinking. You will report to the Head, People Science. The Critical Tasks You Will Perform Build an organisational listening and action engine using employee listening, workforce, behavioural, and operational data to identify signals, diagnose root causes, and guide action. Build user-centric AI systems and agents that automate People Science workflows, from data discovery and analysis to hypothesis testing, programme evaluation, insight generation, and recommendations. Conduct applied organisational research using qualitative and quantitative methods, including surveys, interviews, experiments, and mixed-method approaches. Design hypotheses and evaluate People programmes or interventions using appropriate research, experimental, or quasi-experimental methods. Act as a strategic advisor to People and business leaders by framing ambiguous problems, conducting analysis, evaluating options, and translating evidence into practical decisions. Democratise people data through accessible AI agents, self-service tools, and data products that help non-technical users make better decisions. jobs.description_text: Get to Know the Team Join our Demand and Personalization Data Science team, where machine learning, economics, and large-scale engineering intersect. We build the core ranking, recommendation, and algorithmic incentive systems that determine what millions of users see and which merchant offers they receive across Southeast Asia. Our work directly drives discovery, engagement, and platform marketplace efficiency at scale, operating within high-throughput, low-latency production environments. Get to Know the Role We are looking for a Data Scientist to develop, deploy, and operate production-grade ranking and recommendation models. Reporting to the Data Science Manager II, this is a full-time 24 months contract role based onsite at the Grab One-North Singapore office. You'll collaborate with senior data scientists, product managers, and software engineers to own models end-to-end—from feature engineering and offline experimentation to live deployment and monitoring. If you're passionate about solving high-stakes marketplace algorithms at consumer scale, we invite you to apply. The Critical Tasks You Will Perform Design, optimize, and maintain training-data and feature extraction pipelines across regional markets, ensuring data integrity and system reliability (including participating in team on-call rotations). Formulate, engineer, and validate new user and merchant personalization signals to measurably improve discovery relevance, CTR, and conversion. Formulate testable algorithmic hypotheses, run online A/B experiments, and monitor long-term holdout groups to rigorously measure business and user impact. Collaborate with Engineering to design, deploy, and scale real-time recommendation services and automated incentive allocation systems under strict SLA and latency budgets. Manage production ML operations, including automated retraining pipelines, feature backfills, telemetry, and proactive drift monitoring. Leverage Generative AI (GenAI) coding tools and AI-assisted workflows to accelerate model prototyping, automate repetitive data scripts, and drive team innovation. What Essential Skills You Will Need At least 1 year of hands-on industry experience as a Data Scientist or Machine Learning Engineer focusing on ranking, recommendation systems, or search (or an advanced degree in Computer Science, Statistics, Operations Research, or a related field with relevant production internship experience). Demonstrated experience with learning-to-rank algorithms, CTR/CVR prediction, relevance modelling, or two-tower retrieval architectures (e.g., GBDT, deep ranking models). Experience with offline ranking evaluation metrics (e.g., NDCG, MRR, AUC, MAP) alongside practical experience designing, analyzing, and interpreting online A/B tests. Programming proficiency in Python and SQL, with at least 1 year of practical experience building and debugging production pipelines using Apache Spark and Airflow. Practical understanding of deploying ML models into real-world production environments, handling latency tradeoffs, and monitoring pipeline health. Experience engaging with AI tools and emerging technologies to enhance productivity, improve workflows, and contribute new ideas. jobs.description_text: Get to Know the Team The Financial Services (FS) Analytics team is the analytics and data function for Grab Financial Services which includes the Digibanks — GXS Bank (Singapore) and GX Bank (Malaysia). You will be part of the Save & Spend (SNS) Tech Family (TF) analytics team. The TF mission is to power smarter saving, investing and spending across Southeast Asia, and to make every dollar move efficiently and work for customers. Product coverage spans Deposits, Investments, Cards (Debit and Credit), Consumer Payments, Wallet, and GrabKios / Digital Goods / Agent Network. Get to Know the Role As the Senior Data Scientist (Analytics), you'll report into the Senior Analytics Manager and work onsite in Grab One North Singapore office. You'll use data to understand user needs and be the de-facto Voice of the Customer (users, driver-partners, merchants, agents) across the Save and Spend TF suite of products. You'll use data to unveil insights to help launch, improve and scale our products. You'll champion data-driven decision-making within Grab Financial Services and partner with Product Managers, Business Owners, UX Designers, Marketing and Engineers to design analytical solutions that drive the Product roadmap. You'll provide thought leadership and generate data-driven hypotheses to solve key Product and Business problems, and drive our Financial Services strategies forward. The Critical Tasks You Will Perform You will partner with product, design, and engineering teams to derive insights, design experiments, and drive key product decisions. You will support strategic plans with data insights, performing deep-dives into user behaviour, segmented views and product efficacy. You will provide tailored analysis for specific products and strategies, define critical business and product metrics, and make regular recommendations for continuous improvements. You will design, measure, and recommend A/B tests and multivariate experiments, including layout optimisation, UI/UX efficacy, algorithm effectiveness, and API performance. You will analyse clickstream and transactional data to uncover insights on user behaviour and drive product metrics. You will manage instrumentation for all feature releases within assigned PST. You will develop self-serve solutions for stakeholders that are scalable and automated to handle a product environment. You will drive plans involving Large Language Models or Generative Artificial Intelligence. What Essential Skills You Will Need You have at least 4 years of experience in Analytics, Business Intelligence, or Data Science, in a Tech (FinTech or E-Commerce) company or Financial Institution. You have a Bachelor's Degree in Statistics, Analytics, Economics, Mathematics, Engineering, or related fields. You are proficient in writing advanced SQL queries and querying large relational databases. You have hands-on experience with data analysis and programming tools such as Python or R. You have skill in data visualisation platforms like Tableau or PowerBI or D3.js to present findings. You have experience designing, running, and analysing A/B tests and product experiments, with knowledge of hypothesis testing and the basic principles of Design of Experiments (DoE). We partner with Product, Engineering, Operations, and Business teams to understand support touchpoints, reduce customer friction, and improve operational resolution efficiency. Our culture is collaborative, curious, and deeply grounded in data rigour and experimentation. Get to Know the Role We are looking for a Senior Data Scientist / Senior Product Analyst to help our product and business teams make data-driven, objective decisions and lead the design of controlled experiments. You will collaborate cross-functionally with Product Managers, Engineers, Designers, and Data Scientists to define data requirements, identify key success metrics, and translate complex datasets into actionable insights. You will also evaluate the feasibility of new product ideas and customer support initiatives to maximize user satisfaction and operational impact. You will report to the Product Analytics Manager and work onsite at the Grab Singapore One North office. If you are passionate about applying analytical rigour and experimentation to solve real-world problems at scale, apply today! The Critical Tasks You Will Perform You will partner with Product, Business, Engineering, and Design teams to define data requirements, establish core KPIs, and deliver data-backed recommendations on new product feature feasibility. You will design, implement, and analyze rigorous controlled experiments (A/B testing and quasi-experiments) to validate product hypotheses and guide product launch decisions. You will develop and maintain analytical frameworks, statistical models, and data pipelines to evaluate support workflows and user journeys. You will proactively monitor key business and operational metrics, conducting deep-dive root cause analyses (RCA) on shifts and anomalies to surface rapid, actionable interventions. You will leverage Generative AI (GAI) and emerging productivity tools to optimize analytical workflows, automate query and code generation, and improve reporting efficiency. What Essential Skills You Will Need You have at least 4 years of experience in data-related or quantitative fields such as Product Analytics, Data Science, Statistics, or Mathematics. You have hands-on experience handling large-scale datasets, distributed computing environments, and maintaining robust data transformation workflows. jobs.description_text:
About HeyGen

At HeyGen, our mission is to make visual storytelling accessible to all. Over the last decade, visual content has become the preferred method of information creation, consumption, and retention. But the ability to create such content, in particular videos, continues to be costly and challenging to scale. Our ambition is to build technology that equips more people with the power to reach, captivate, and inspire audiences.
Learn more at www.heygen.com. Visit our Mission and Culture doc here.

Driving Product Innovation with Advanced Computer Vision Technology

HeyGen is a dynamic startup at the forefront of revolutionizing video content with state-of-the-art artificial intelligence technology. With a robust track record of growth and a proven business model, we are rapidly carving out a leadership position in the AI-powered video creation industry. We are in search of passionate Research Scientists with a specialization in Computer Vision to propel our mission forward. If you are eager to deploy your advanced skills to disrupt and redefine the video creation and interaction experience, your next big opportunity awaits with us.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Applied Innovation and Product Development: Harness your knowledge of generative models, including GANs, Diffusion models, and other multi-modal models, to propel our video creation tools forward. Your role involves translating state-of-the-art research into innovative features that directly enhance our user experience and set our products apart.

  • Real-World Solutions: Channel your research capabilities to develop scalable solutions that have a significant impact on our platform, making the video creation process more intuitive, powerful, and accessible to our users.

  • Collaborative Engineering and Growth: Engage with a diverse team where collaborative efforts lead to extraordinary outcomes. Embrace an environment that promotes learning, mentorship, and teamwork, furthering both personal development and the advancement of our technology.

Qualifications:

  • A Master's or PhD in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field
  • 1-3 years of experience in machine learning and computer vision, demonstrating practical application of generative models and a passion for product-centric innovation.
  • Proficiency in Python, with openness to other programming languages and tools as required by project demands.
  • Experience with deep learning frameworks such as PyTorch, and a capacity for quickly mastering new technologies.
  • A collaborative spirit with a proven track record in a team-based research or development setting.
  • A lifelong learner with outstanding problem-solving skills and the ability to communicate effectively in a diverse team environment.

What HeyGen Offers:

  • Competitive Salary and Benefits: We offer a salary commensurate with your experience and a comprehensive benefits package that addresses a variety of needs.
  • Innovative and Inclusive Work Environment: Our workplace is designed to inspire innovation through collaboration, respect, and mutual support.
  • Opportunities for Advancement: We are committed to your professional development, offering extensive opportunities for learning, mentorship, and career growth.

jobs.title: Research Engineer

jobs.description_text:
About HeyGen

At HeyGen, our mission is to make visual storytelling accessible to all. Over the last decade, visual content has become the preferred method of information creation, consumption, and retention. But the ability to create such content, in particular videos, continues to be costly and challenging to scale. Our ambition is to build technology that equips more people with the power to reach, captivate, and inspire audiences.
Learn more at www.heygen.com. Visit our Mission and Culture doc here.

Position Summary

HeyGen is building AI applications including Avatar IV, Photo Avatar, Interactive Avatar, and Video Translation. We’re looking for a Software Engineer focused on GPU performance to make the systems behind these experiences faster and more efficient.

You will work across model execution and inference infrastructure, using profiling and measurement to improve latency, throughput, and GPU cost. This role is a fit for an engineer who enjoys understanding how software uses the hardware beneath it.

Key Responsibilities

  • Use NVIDIA Nsight Systems, Nsight Compute, and PyTorch Profiler to investigate GPU utilization, kernel execution, memory bandwidth, and CPU–GPU data movement.
  • Identify bottlenecks across model execution, preprocessing, and inference serving, then measure the impact of each optimization.
  • Improve performance through batching, scheduling, memory management, and better GPU utilization.
  • Develop or integrate high-performance GPU kernels when existing implementations limit performance.
  • Build benchmarks and automated checks that catch performance regressions across representative video workloads.
  • Collaborate with AI researchers and infrastructure engineers to bring optimizations into production.
  • Measure the effect of changes on latency, throughput, cost, and output quality.

Qualifications

  • Experience optimizing GPU-based AI workloads or high-performance computing systems.
  • Proficiency in Python and experience with PyTorch or a similar machine learning framework.
  • Strong curiosity about GPU hardware, including memory bandwidth, cache behavior, tensor cores, and data movement between CPU and GPU.
  • Experience using profiling tools to connect hardware behavior to application-level bottlenecks and validate improvements.
  • Ability to turn performance experiments into reliable production changes and communicate tradeoffs clearly.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with CUDA, Triton, or C++ GPU programming.
  • Experience optimizing video, image, audio, diffusion, or Transformer models.
  • Familiarity with multi-GPU inference, GPU interconnects, quantization, or large-scale model serving.
  • Experience building performance benchmarks or regression testing infrastructure.
  • Prior experience in a fast-paced technology environment.

What HeyGen Offers

  • Competitive salary and benefits package.
  • Dynamic and inclusive work environment.
  • Opportunities for professional growth and advancement.
  • Collaborative culture that values innovation and creativity.
  • Access to the latest technologies and tools.

HeyGen is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

Join us at HeyGen

Help us make AI video faster and more accessible. We’d love to hear from you.
